purpose: Protected test-only claim/close truthfulness handoff; the builder owns the combined implementation PR.

commands.runtime: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot --bin two-bot ticket_runtime::claim_close_truth_acceptance_tests:: -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
commands.controls: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-core --test ticket_claim_close_truth_controls -- --nocapture

database.missingEnvironment: Six runtime cases explicitly print SKIP and return; that is not behavioral evidence.
database.ciRoute: check.yml rust-tests workspace lib/bins step supplies the guarded disposable database; the integration step discovers the core target.
database.fixtures: Disposable test database and loopback Discord only; never live Discord or staging/production databases.

contract.marker: Visible claimant mention after the claim commits, with allowed_mentions.parse empty; event replay adds no post.
contract.markerFailure: A 403 produces exactly one post attempt, leaves the claim committed and successful, and emits one structured ticket claim marker failed event with failed=1. Replay adds no post or failure event. Do not echo remote bodies.
contract.refusals: A competing staff member learns the stored claimant from the shared router's mention-suppressed reply; closing refuses for lifecycle state, not ownership.
contract.close: Disclose actual transcript truncation, state the up-to-90-day ceiling, and do not promise an unavailable transcript read path. Complete capture does not claim truncation.
contract.controls: No permission, cooldown, claimant, stale-close, cleanup/recovery, retention or close-replay semantic changes.

handoff: Do not edit protected files. Return test corrections to their author. Do not merge a deliberately red test-only PR.
